title: Fix the seconds divisor in formatDuration
text:
src/duration.js formats a millisecond duration for the run log. The
contract is:

  ms < 1000    -> Math.round(ms) + "ms"        (e.g. 250 -> "250ms")
  ms < 60000   -> (ms / 1000).toFixed(1) + "s" (e.g. 1500 -> "1.5s")
  otherwise    -> "<m>m <s>s" with m = Math.floor(ms / 60000) and
                  s = Math.round((ms % 60000) / 1000)  (90000 -> "1m 30s")

The seconds conversion divides by 100 instead of 1000, so every
duration above a second is reported ten times too large. Fix
src/duration.js only. Keep the existing tests in test/ passing.
